content.descriptor: Jelly Ko: Korean refillable skincare for dry, dehydrated and perimenopausal skin, created by K-beauty expert Lauren Lee
about: Jelly Ko is a Korean skincare brand created by Lauren Lee, host of a Korean beauty podcast, developed together with Korean cosmetic chemists. We built it for women experiencing skin changes — including perimenopause — whose skin has become dry, dehydrated or reactive and is underserved by products that are either too rich or too thin, or by sensitive-skin ranges we see as underpowered. Our legal address is in Gangnam, Seoul; we make our formulas in Korea.

Our range covers cleansing, toning, serums, a night mask, a lip mask and acne-spot patches, built around a small set of active ingredients at stated concentrations rather than a long multi-step routine. Four of our core products — the Bubble Tea Steam Cream, Dewy Glaze Toner, White Truffle Soufflé Serum and Be Jelly Overnight Dream Serum — ship with a separate refill pouch or jar insert, which, by our estimate, cuts single-use plastic and glass per item by more than 80%. The refill packaging uses recycled paper and soy ink, and the included scoop is zinc rather than plastic.

We have no exclusive distributor in any market. Since mid-2026 we have shipped to Latin America through a global distributor, and we already sell in Korea, Australia, the United States and other markets through pharmacies, spas and clinics, marketplaces and our own site. We can share supporting documents for a market's registration process on request. Teranova has not independently verified these sales and distribution claims beyond what is stated in Jelly Ko's own brand materials.

catalog_notes: Our top-selling product: a 3-in-1 oil + serum + cream with niacinamide 2%, adenosine, panthenol, vitamin E, beta-glucan and squalane, for daily use morning and evening.

The matching refill pouch for the Bubble Tea Steam Cream, with grape seed oil, beta-glucan, niacinamide 2% and adenosine; winner of a Prevention magazine 'Best of Beauty' award for refillable skincare, by our account.

A night mask with our MOISTBOOM complex, cherry blossom extract, niacinamide 2%, panthenol, ectoin 1%, betaine, allantoin and adenosine; a thin layer 20 minutes before bed, rinsed off in the morning, or used as a lightweight day moisturizer.

A combined essence-and-toner step with 84% birch sap, a layered hyaluronic acid complex, arginine, panthenol and berry extracts; applied after cleansing with a cotton pad, then pressed in by hand for a second layer.
The matching refill for the Dewy Glaze Toner, in the same volume; by our estimate it cuts single-use plastic by more than 90%, also sold as a travel pack with a cap.
A multi-functional scrub that turns into foam on contact with water, with glycerin, sucrose and a multi-ceramide complex; used either as a cleanser or, left on damp skin, as an exfoliant.
A hair-tie set matching our Cherry Blossom packaging. Teranova has not identified an ingredient or care-instruction page for this accessory in Jelly Ko's materials.

A lip sleeping mask with 9 essential amino acids, shea butter, sunflower seed oil, jojoba seed oil and moringa seed oil, applied with an included zinc scoop that doubles as a mini gua sha tool; a thin layer by day, a thicker layer overnight.

A soufflé-textured serum for very dry, sensitive and compromised skin, with European white truffle, shea butter, licorice, centella asiatica, sodium hyaluronate and adenosine, without added dyes, fragrance or essential oils; one to two pumps before a moisturizer.
The matching refill for the White Truffle Soufflé Serum, in the same volume; by our estimate it cuts single-use plastic and glass by more than 80%, also sold as a travel pack.

A gel-textured night serum with retinol, collagen, panthenol, squalane and four types of hyaluronic acid, for texture and tone; a thin layer before night cream, starting at one to two times a week and building up gradually.
The matching refill and travel pack for the Be Jelly Overnight Dream Serum, in the same volume and with the same use.
Ultra-thin, drug-free hydrocolloid patches for blemish spots, applied to clean dry skin and left on for 6–12 hours or overnight.
A silicone brush for applying jar-packed creams and masks without fingers, reducing product waste; rinses clean with warm water.
